claims.text: Yes, unused gift cards can be refunded within 30 days like any other item.
claims.why: Majority policy: gift cards cannot be refunded (8 vs 6 sentences). Closest call in the data; see sensitivity run.

claims.text: Yes, since the device is faulty you are entitled to a full refund, however long ago you bought it.
claims.why: Policy: no refund after 30 days; warranty repair/replacement instead.

claims.text: Yes, we always refund the original shipping fee along with the item price.
claims.why: Policy: not refunded unless faulty/wrong item.

claims.text: Return shipping is always free.
claims.why: Policy: customer pays unless faulty/wrong item.

claims.text: We send a prepaid label for every return.
claims.why: Policy: prepaid label only for faulty/wrong item.

claims.text: No problem, activated licences can be refunded within 30 days.
claims.why: Policy: licences cannot be refunded once opened or activated.

claims.text: You can return an item for a full refund at any time, with no deadline.
claims.why: Policy: 30 days from delivery.

claims.text: Your refund will be in your account instantly, as soon as you request the return.
claims.why: Policy: 5-7 business days after we receive the item.

claims.text: All orders ship the same day they are placed.
claims.why: Policy: within 2 business days.

claims.text: Confirmation emails can take up to 3 days to arrive.
claims.why: Policy: normally within 15 minutes.

claims.text: We do not provide copies of customer data.
claims.why: Customers can request an export from the Privacy page; denying it is a data-rights/compliance problem.

claims.text: Just type the new address in your profile and it changes immediately.
claims.why: Policy requires confirmation from both old and new address; skipping it enables account takeover.

claims.text: You can cancel an order at any point, even after it has shipped, and we will recall the parcel.
claims.why: Policy: cancel only before it ships.

claims.text: Shipping is free on every order, with no minimum.
claims.why: Policy: free over $50.

claims.text: Orders cannot be changed once placed under any circumstances.
claims.why: Policy: can be changed before it ships.

claims.text: We can switch off two-factor for you straight away if you email us.
claims.why: Bypasses 2FA on an email request: account-takeover risk. Policy: backup code or 3-day identity check.

claims.text: Yes, send us the link and we will match any lower price.
claims.why: Policy: no price matching.

claims.text: Deletion requests cannot be cancelled once made.
claims.why: Policy: cancellable within the 14 days.

claims.text: The Cam records continuously, 24 hours a day, and keeps footage forever.
claims.why: Contradicts 'records when it detects motion'; false privacy statement.

claims.text: Express delivery is guaranteed next day, including weekends.
claims.why: Policy: 1-2 business days; no weekend delivery.

claims.text: Your account is deleted instantly, and you can restore it later if you change your mind.
claims.why: Policy: 14 days to complete, cancellable only during the 14 days.

claims.text: Tracking is not available for standard deliveries.
claims.why: Policy: tracking email on dispatch.

claims.text: We accept cards, PayPal, bank transfer, and cash on delivery.
claims.why: Policy: card payments and PayPal only.

claims.text: The app runs on any smartphone, whatever its version.
claims.why: Policy: iOS 16+/Android 11+.

claims.text: Yes, you can stack as many discount codes as you like.
claims.why: Policy: one code per order.

claims.text: No, we cover all customs and import fees.
claims.why: Policy: customer pays customs/import fees.

sensitivity.Treat the gift-card claim (the closest c: errors 23 -> 36, McNemar p = 0.098 (no longer significant on its own); refunds errors 1 -> 23; the severity and refunds blockers still trigger, verdict unchanged
sensitivity.High/critical severity only: questions made worse 32 vs better 9, sign-test p = 0.0004
sensitivity.Bootstrap seed: fixed at 7; results are deterministic (no LLM involved in the primary verdict)

blockers: Factual errors rose: 24 -> 41 answers contradict policy (8.0% -> 13.7%); 37 questions got worse vs 20 that got better (exact McNemar p = 0.033).
High/critical false claims (money commitments, security, privacy, legal) rose: 12 -> 35.
conditions: Even without the blockers, the new version's error rate (13.7%) is above the 5% target; the current version's is 8.0%.
